newsitem.title: USA: Hexcel sees Q4 charge of $0.16/shr.
newsitem.headline: Hexcel sees Q4 charge of $0.16/shr.

text.p: Hexcel Corp said on Tuesday it sees a fourth-quarter charge of about $7 million before taxes, or $0.16 per share after tax, related to its ongoing consolidation program.

The company said it was implementing further consolidation as part of its ongoing integration, announced in May, of the composites businesses of Ciba-Geigy and Hercules Inc, both acquired during 1996.

The new business consolidation actions relate to the elimination of additional jobs in European manufacturing overhead personnel and further consolidation of manufacturing operations within France, the company said.
The cash cost of these actions is estimated at about $7 million, of which about $5 million will be reported as business consolidation expense.
The company said that following the acquisition of the Hercules unit, the business consolidation plan has been adjusted to take advantage of the acquired manufacturing capabilities.

With these and other adjustments to the program, the total expense is now estimated at about $58 million and the cash costs net of estimated proceeds from asset sales are estimated at about $51 million.

The company said it has already recognized $36 million of business consolidation expense through the first three quarters of 1996. Of the remaining $22 million, it expects to take the $7 million or $0.16 per share charge in the fourth quarter, and expense the other $15 million in declining amounts over 1997.
Once fully implemented in 1999, the company said the revised program is expected to produce cost savings of about $32 million per year.
The program will take up to three years to complete because of aerospace industry requirements for certification, the company said.
